name: Spring Break (Getaway Crag, David Thompson)
approach: Park at the David Thompson Highway pullout. Follow well-marked cairned trail heading uphill through open timber for ~30-40 minutes directly below the limestone band.
notes: Well-bolted warm-up line on solid grey limestone. Fast lowering anchors. Watch for loose rock on the upper ledge.

name: Cascade Mountain Normal Route (Banff)
approach: Start from Cascade Ponds parking lot. Follow well-traveled trail up through lower forest and scree bowls to the amphitheatre ridge.
notes: Helmet mandatory due to rockfall risk from climbers above. Carry glacier glasses and wind gear for the summit plateau.
